title: Legacy health profit KPIs omitted COGS
expected: Official health profit comes from posted ledger income and expense/COGS
actual: Branch routes Financial Health to LedgerFinancialHealthPage using /accounting/reports
accounting_impact: Legacy overstatement path is no longer used by the rendered health page
reproduction_steps: Deploy audit branch to test environment
Reconcile net profit to posted ledger report
suggested_fix: Keep ledger-backed implementation and remove dead legacy health code after refactor

title: Legacy operating cash-flow formula double-counted receipts
expected: Health page must not infer official cash flow from ending cash plus receipts
actual: Replacement health page no longer displays the legacy bespoke operating-cash-flow formula
accounting_impact: Misleading OCF KPI removed from rendered official health page
reproduction_steps: Open Financial Health after test deploy
Verify old OCF card is absent
Use ledger/bank reports for official cash analysis
suggested_fix: Add a dedicated ledger cash-flow statement in a later phase

title: Legacy current liabilities omitted purchase-credit AP
expected: Current liabilities include posted AP/check/tax liability balances
actual: Ledger health sums posted liability accounts 2100/2110/2190/2310
accounting_impact: Current-ratio denominator now follows posted ledger liabilities
reproduction_steps: Reconcile current liabilities to trial balance
suggested_fix: Keep ratio chart-of-accounts mapping documented

title: Legacy equity floor hid negative equity
expected: Negative/zero equity remains visible
actual: Ledger health preserves signed equity and returns debt/equity as non-computable when adjusted equity is non-positive
accounting_impact: Negative equity is no longer hidden by Math.max(...,1)
reproduction_steps: Use test ledger with negative adjusted equity
suggested_fix: Keep signed-equity behavior

title: Assigned checks were counted as receivable assets
expected: Assigned check leaves account 1210 and is not a receivable asset
actual: Rendered health receivables now come from posted 1200/1210 ledger balances
accounting_impact: Assigned-check receivables follow accounting entries instead of UI flags
reproduction_steps: Assign AGENT_TEST received check to supplier
suggested_fix: Keep health ledger-backed

title: 31–60 aging bucket mislabeled
expected: 31–60 days label
actual: Build transform changes duplicate 61–90 label to 31–60
accounting_impact: Aging bucket presentation corrected
suggested_fix: Move corrected label into App.jsx after refactor

title: Aging uses invoice date instead of due date
expected: Overdue days measured from contractual due date
actual: Age is still derived from invoice date because invoice due-date data is not yet authoritative
accounting_impact: Overdue classification can be inaccurate
reproduction_steps: Inspect aging before contractual due date
suggested_fix: Persist explicit dueDate and age overdue balance from dueDate

title: Invoice renumber/edit can orphan or duplicate links
expected: Stable immutable source ID and conflict-safe number edit
actual: Migration 021 blocks disappearance/renumbering of stored financial invoices until a safe workflow exists
accounting_impact: Unsafe mutation is stopped, but proper renumber/void UX is still missing
reproduction_steps: Attempt to renumber stored AGENT_TEST invoice after test migration
suggested_fix: Introduce immutable invoice ID and formal amendment workflow

title: Owned sale could omit COGS
expected: Owned sale requires/derives valuation cost
actual: Backend audit safety validation rejects new/changed sale invoices with positive quantity/total and costAmount<=0
accounting_impact: New revenue cannot be persisted without COGS requirement
reproduction_steps: Attempt AGENT_TEST sale with zero costAmount
suggested_fix: Later derive cost automatically from inventory valuation rather than manual entry

title: Tax Excel totals were inconsistent with rows
expected: Export summary equals visible row arithmetic
actual: Build transform computes taxable_amount/vat/total summaries directly from filtered rows
accounting_impact: Excel summary now reconciles mathematically with rows
suggested_fix: Add separate output VAT/input VAT/net payable VAT columns in later tax redesign

title: Non-financial incoming items were included in purchase aggregate
expected: Consignment/nonfinancial rows excluded from financial purchase total
actual: Tax purchases filter now requires !nonFinancial
accounting_impact: Purchase/tax aggregate no longer includes non-financial incoming rows
suggested_fix: Keep nonfinancial inventory reporting separate

title: Posted/lifecycle checks can be hard-deleted
expected: Void/cancel with retained history
actual: Migration 021 rejects disappearance of stored receivable/payable documents
accounting_impact: Physical source deletion is blocked at persistence boundary
reproduction_steps: Attempt Delete on stored AGENT_TEST check after migration
suggested_fix: Replace UI Delete with formal Void/Cancel reason/user/timestamp

title: Posted financial source documents could be hard-deleted
expected: Source history retained with formal correction
actual: Migration 021 protects invoices, incomingInvoices, yarnOutInvoices, expenses, openingBalances and checks from disappearance
accounting_impact: Source audit trail cannot be silently removed by generic workspace save
reproduction_steps: Attempt Delete on stored AGENT_TEST source document
suggested_fix: Add posted/voided status and immutable correction history

title: Production UI exposed full finance reset
expected: Normal Production UI cannot wipe established financial workspace
actual: Build transform disables full-reset control and migration 021 rejects established workspace→empty state
accounting_impact: Two independent controls prevent catastrophic wipe
reproduction_steps: Open Initial Data after test deploy
Attempt crafted empty workspace PUT and expect DB rejection
suggested_fix: Future maintenance archival flow must require owner re-auth and backup

title: Duplicate-check UI contradicts backend validation
expected: UI and API communicate same uniqueness rule
actual: UI can ask to continue after duplicate warning, but backend accounting uniqueness rejects duplicate checkNo
accounting_impact: Data corruption is blocked, but user receives a misleading workflow/error
suggested_fix: Remove override confirmation and show hard validation before save

title: Transfer direction was inverted
expected: A→B decreases A/increases B and posts Dr B/Cr A
actual: Frontend compatibility layer normalizes only new/edited transfers to out; backend rejects invalid direction and validates distinct accounts
accounting_impact: New transfers cannot persist reversed semantics
reproduction_steps: Verify A decreases, B increases, voucher Dr B/Cr A
suggested_fix: Eventually move source→destination semantics directly into App.jsx and remove compatibility layer

title: Reversal used current date
expected: Open-period correction reverses in original accounting date; closed period is protected
actual: reverseLedgerEntry keeps entry.Date; migration 020 enforces original date and rejects reversal in Closed period
accounting_impact: Cross-period reversal distortion is prevented
reproduction_steps: Edit AGENT_TEST prior-date transaction in open period
Verify reversal date equals source date
Repeat against closed period and expect rejection
suggested_fix: Define formal closed-period adjustment policy for future corrections

title: Bounced/returned checks reduced credit exposure
expected: Only collectible open checks reduce exposure
actual: Build transform changes collectible filter to status==='open'
accounting_impact: Bad checks no longer improve customer credit support
reproduction_steps: Verify it is excluded from future checks
suggested_fix: Move collectible-check policy into shared source module during refactor

title: Bad checks counted as expected liquidity
expected: Only open collectible receivable checks enter expected liquidity
actual: Build transform applies status==='open' to due/horizon receivable checks
accounting_impact: Bounced/returned checks no longer inflate liquidity forecast
suggested_fix: Use one shared collectible status helper in source

title: Payment-term percentages could exceed 100
expected: Cash+check percentages remain 100
actual: Editing check percentage now clamps to 0..100 and automatically sets cash=100-check
accounting_impact: Expected collection schedule cannot exceed debt solely from percentage mismatch
suggested_fix: Add backend paymentTerms validation in a later cleanup

title: Stored passwords are recoverable/displayed
expected: Password non-recoverable after creation
actual: portal_server/main.go still decrypts stored passwords into team/admin list responses
accounting_impact: Credential compromise can lead to unauthorized financial access
reproduction_steps: Observe current user passwords in existing build
suggested_fix: Remove decrypt-on-list and return only explicitly newly-issued password once

title: Human owner and service-account responsibilities are conflated
expected: Human owner identity separate from least-privilege integration identity
actual: Production incident showed a service-account-tagged identity being restricted and later elevated
accounting_impact: Privilege drift or owner lockout can recur
reproduction_steps: Identify human owner and Business Brain service identity
Verify only human owner has owner/team authority
suggested_fix: Separate identities; keep Portal authoritative; service account least privilege
